That being said, the Lightning network lets you send US dollars over Lightning network and have it arrive in dollars on the other end.  Zero volatility, no tax implications, merchant saves 3% on credit card fees.

@TeslaAndDoge @McDonalds We aren't debating whether I do bitcoin or you do doge.  We are debating whether it makes more sense for multinational corporations to adopt bitcoin payments via Lightning or Dogecoin payments via base layer transactions.

@TeslaAndDoge @McDonalds No, no, no. We aren't comparing Dogecoin and Bitcoin base layers. We are comparing Dogecoin to Lightning.  Lightning is instantaneous final settlement. Doge requires 1 minute per block and a bunch of confirmations. Why wait 5+ minutes for a burger payment to go through?
